entries.title: More sources and caption timing
items: Seven new movie sources: Ember, Vortex, Zephyr, Onyx, Echo, Haven and Comet, plus every Flux mirror on its own.
If a source fails or stalls, the player moves on to the next one by itself, and looks for more once they've all failed.
Caption timing: nudge subtitles earlier or later from the captions menu when they're out of sync.
Custom font: pick Custom under Settings > Appearance > Font and type any Google Fonts name to use it everywhere.

entries.title: Orbit removed
items: Orbit is gone from the source list: its streams stopped loading, so picking it only led to an error.

entries.title: New sources and player controls
items: Two new movie sources: Orbit and Prism join the lineup, so more titles have a working stream.
Source switcher: sources now have codenames and expanding them shows the available qualities.
Caption controls: a master on/off switch at the top, with the language list nested underneath.

entries.title: Server switcher
items: Pick a Breeze server yourself in Settings, Proxy, or leave it on Auto to use the first one that's working.

entries.title: Custom backgrounds, glass, custom accents and game downloads
items: Custom backgrounds: upload an image or paste a link in Settings, Appearance, and set how much it is dimmed.
Glass: a new Appearance switch that makes panels, buttons and menus frosted and see-through.
Custom accent: pick any colour from the new Custom option in the accent list.
Download the game you're playing: the new button next to close saves it as an HTML file. It still loads the game's files from Breeze, so you need to be online.

entries.title: Release!
items: Welcome to Breeze! Thanks for stopping by. If you like this website, share it with friends.
